RE: Account reference: ACC-668507

Dear Ms. Moore,

Receiving your dispute regarding the account referenced above, we acknowledge your assertion that you did not provide written permission for the transactions associated with this account to be included in your consumer report. We understand that you are requesting that these accounts be blocked and removed from your report.

Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), we are required to investigate your dispute and respond within a reasonable time period. We will conduct an investigation into the matter, reviewing our records and any relevant documentation.

As per your request, we will also provide you with a validation of the debt, as required by the FDCPA. This validation will include information about the original creditor, Cornerstone Community Bank, and the current balance of $10,115.93.

Please be advised that we will not take any action to block or remove the account from your report at this time. However, we will continue to investigate your dispute and will provide you with an update on our findings.

You have the right to further dispute this account if you believe the validation provided does not accurately reflect the debt. If you wish to continue disputing this account, please respond to this letter within 30 days.

Sincerely,

Pinnacle Asset Management
